title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Extension Schedule
content:
Extensions of a Builder Extended Rate Lock are bought in increments of calendar days, and both the size of an increment and the limits on extensions depend on the lock term.

## Extension figures by term

| Lock term | Calendar days in one increment | Extension fee per increment (percent of the loan amount) | Minimum extension fee per increment (USD) | Maximum increments per lock | Maximum total extension days per lock | First increment carries no fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | 7 | 0.125% | 150.00 | 3 | 21 | No |
| 90-Day Lock | 7 | 0.125% | 150.00 | 3 | 21 | No |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | 15 | 0.125% | 250.00 | 2 | 30 | No |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | 15 | 0.125% | 250.00 | 2 | 30 | Yes |
| 270-Day Build Lock | 30 | 0.250% | 350.00 | 2 | 60 | Yes |
| 360-Day Build Lock | 30 | 0.250% | 350.00 | 1 | 30 | Yes |

## Builder-delay waiver percent

| Lock term | Percent of an extension charge waived when the extension was needed because of a builder delay |
|---|---|
| All six terms | 100% |

## Notes

- The two limits run over the life of the lock: the maximum number of increments and the maximum total calendar days of extensions.
- The first-increment column records whether the first extension increment carries no fee; it reads Yes only on the 180-Day Extended Lock and the two Build Locks.
